A '''timer fuse''' was a device used to control the detonation of [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]]<ref name="SWS" /> such as [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] criminal [[Sufar]] employed them.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> Timer fuses were readily available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and cost fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" />
